description: Raw weight a scale step resolves to. Factor steps scale the base portion; unit steps multiply the unit weight and IGNORE the base portion entirely. Returns an unrounded value on purpose — rounding happens once, at display or storage, never here.

cases.why: Half of 75 g is 37.5 g, and it stays 37.5 — pins that this function does not round.
Two carrots weigh 148 g regardless of the 75 g base portion passed in. A port that also multiplies by the base portion is wrong by a factor of 75.
Half a carrot is 37 g exactly, so this case happens to be integral — it is here to show fractional counts are supported at all, not only whole items.
